make.label: Make Array
make.description: Builds a new array from the given elements, in order.

length.label: Array Length
length.description: Returns how many elements are in the array.

get.label: Array Get
get.description: Returns the element at an index, and whether it existed.

set.label: Array Set
set.description: Replaces the element at an index, if the index is in bounds.

add.label: Array Add
add.description: Appends a value to the end of the array.

append.label: Array Append
append.description: Concatenates two arrays into one, keeping order and duplicates.

insert.label: Array Insert
insert.description: Inserts a value at an index, shifting later elements over.

removeAt.label: Array Remove At
removeAt.description: Removes the element at an index, if the index is in bounds.

removeItem.label: Array Remove Item
removeItem.description: Removes the first element that matches a given value.

clear.label: Array Clear
clear.description: Returns an empty array, discarding all elements.

contains.label: Array Contains
contains.description: True if the array contains this value anywhere.

findIndex.label: Array Find Index
findIndex.description: Returns the index of the first matching element, or -1.

isEmpty.label: Array Is Empty
isEmpty.description: True if the array has no elements.

reverse.label: Array Reverse
reverse.description: Returns a copy of the array with elements in reverse order.

forEach.label: Array For Each
forEach.description: Runs the loop body once for each array element, in order.

basic.label: Basic Auth
basic.description: Builds an HTTP Basic Auth header value from a username and password.

oauth2ClientCredentials.label: OAuth2 Client Credentials
oauth2ClientCredentials.description: Requests an access token from an OAuth2 token endpoint using the client credentials grant (client ID and secret, no user involved).

oauth2Saml.label: OAuth2 SAML Bearer
oauth2Saml.description: Fetches a signed SAML assertion from an IdP endpoint, then exchanges it for an OAuth2 access token from a token endpoint, using a named Credential Vault entry.

authorize.label: Dropbox Authorize
authorize.description: One-time setup step: reads a named Credential Vault entry's App Key/App Secret/Authorization Code and exchanges the code for a long-lived refresh token to save back into the vault. Every other Dropbox node uses that refresh token (via its own Credential Name pin) automatically, refreshing its access token on demand.

upload.label: Dropbox Upload
upload.description: Uploads content to a path in Dropbox.

download.label: Dropbox Download
download.description: Downloads the content of a file at a path in Dropbox.

listFolders.label: Dropbox List Folders
listFolders.description: Lists the folders under a path in Dropbox, optionally including nested subfolders.

move.label: Dropbox Move
move.description: Moves a file or folder from one Dropbox path to another.

copy.label: Dropbox Copy
copy.description: Copies a file or folder from one Dropbox path to another.

rename.label: Dropbox Rename
rename.description: Renames a file or folder by moving it to a new path within Dropbox.

delete.label: Dropbox Delete
delete.description: Deletes a file or folder at a path in Dropbox.

createFolder.label: Dropbox Create Folder
createFolder.description: Creates a new folder at a path in Dropbox.

getMetadata.label: Dropbox Get Metadata
getMetadata.description: Fetches metadata (size, content hash, last modified) for a file or folder at a path in Dropbox, without downloading its content.

search.label: Dropbox Search
search.description: Searches file and folder names/content across Dropbox (or under a given path) for a query.

listRevisions.label: Dropbox List Revisions
listRevisions.description: Lists the historical revisions of a file at a path in Dropbox.

restore.label: Dropbox Restore
restore.description: Restores a file at a path in Dropbox to a previous revision.

permanentlyDelete.label: Dropbox Permanently Delete
permanentlyDelete.description: Permanently deletes a file or folder at a path in Dropbox, bypassing the trash.

getTemporaryLink.label: Dropbox Get Temporary Link
getTemporaryLink.description: Gets a temporary direct-download link for a file at a path in Dropbox.

getTemporaryUploadLink.label: Dropbox Get Temporary Upload Link
getTemporaryUploadLink.description: Gets a temporary link that can be used to upload directly to a path in Dropbox without proxying the bytes through this server.

moveBatch.label: Dropbox Move Batch
moveBatch.description: Moves multiple files or folders from one Dropbox path to another in a single batch.

copyBatch.label: Dropbox Copy Batch
copyBatch.description: Copies multiple files or folders from one Dropbox path to another in a single batch.

deleteBatch.label: Dropbox Delete Batch
deleteBatch.description: Deletes multiple files or folders at once in Dropbox.

createSharedLink.label: Dropbox Create Shared Link
createSharedLink.description: Creates a public shared link for a file or folder at a path in Dropbox.

listSharedLinks.label: Dropbox List Shared Links
listSharedLinks.description: Lists the shared links for a path (or the whole account, if empty) in Dropbox.

shareFolder.label: Dropbox Share Folder
shareFolder.description: Converts a folder at a path in Dropbox into a shared folder.

addFolderMember.label: Dropbox Add Folder Member
addFolderMember.description: Invites a member by email to an existing shared folder in Dropbox.

getCurrentAccount.label: Dropbox Get Current Account
getCurrentAccount.description: Fetches the account ID, name and email of the Dropbox account an access token belongs to.

getSpaceUsage.label: Dropbox Get Space Usage
getSpaceUsage.description: Fetches the used and allocated storage space (bytes) for a Dropbox account.

listIssues.label: GitHub List Issues
listIssues.description: Lists issues in a GitHub repository, optionally filtered by state.

createIssue.label: GitHub Create Issue
createIssue.description: Creates a new issue in a GitHub repository.

commentOnIssue.label: GitHub Comment On Issue
commentOnIssue.description: Adds a comment to an existing issue in a GitHub repository.

listPullRequests.label: GitHub List Pull Requests
listPullRequests.description: Lists pull requests in a GitHub repository, optionally filtered by state.

createPullRequest.label: GitHub Create Pull Request
createPullRequest.description: Opens a new pull request in a GitHub repository from one branch into another.

mergePullRequest.label: GitHub Merge Pull Request
mergePullRequest.description: Merges an open pull request in a GitHub repository using the chosen merge method.

getFileContent.label: GitHub Get File Content
getFileContent.description: Fetches the decoded text content of a file at a path in a GitHub repository, optionally at a specific branch/tag/commit.

createOrUpdateFile.label: GitHub Create Or Update File
createOrUpdateFile.description: Creates or updates a file at a path in a GitHub repository. Pass the SHA from GitHub Get File Content to update an existing file, or leave it blank to create a new one.

request.label: GitHub Request
request.description: Sends a raw request to any GitHub REST API route not covered by the other GitHub nodes, e.g. "GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}".

listUsers.label: Microsoft 365 List Users
listUsers.description: Lists users in the Azure AD tenant, optionally filtered with an OData $filter expression.

getUser.label: Microsoft 365 Get User
getUser.description: Fetches a single user's profile by ID or user principal name (UPN).

createUser.label: Microsoft 365 Create User
createUser.description: Creates a new user in the Azure AD tenant.

updateUser.label: Microsoft 365 Update User
updateUser.description: Updates a user's properties by ID or UPN using a raw JSON object of the fields to change.

deleteUser.label: Microsoft 365 Delete User
deleteUser.description: Deletes a user from the Azure AD tenant by ID or UPN.

listGroups.label: Microsoft 365 List Groups
listGroups.description: Lists groups in the Azure AD tenant, optionally filtered with an OData $filter expression.

createGroup.label: Microsoft 365 Create Group
createGroup.description: Creates a new security or Microsoft 365 group in the Azure AD tenant.

deleteGroup.label: Microsoft 365 Delete Group
deleteGroup.description: Deletes a group from the Azure AD tenant by ID.

addGroupMember.label: Microsoft 365 Add Group Member
addGroupMember.description: Adds a user as a member of a group by ID.

sendMail.label: Microsoft 365 Send Mail
sendMail.description: Sends an email as a user via Outlook/Exchange Online.

listMessages.label: Microsoft 365 List Messages
listMessages.description: Lists messages in a user's mailbox, optionally filtered with an OData $filter expression.

getMessage.label: Microsoft 365 Get Message
getMessage.description: Fetches a single email message's subject, sender and body content by ID.

deleteMessage.label: Microsoft 365 Delete Message
deleteMessage.description: Deletes an email message from a user's mailbox by ID.

listEvents.label: Microsoft 365 List Events
listEvents.description: Lists events on a user's calendar.

createEvent.label: Microsoft 365 Create Event
createEvent.description: Creates a new event on a user's calendar.

deleteEvent.label: Microsoft 365 Delete Event
deleteEvent.description: Deletes an event from a user's calendar by ID.

listDriveItems.label: Microsoft 365 List Drive Items
listDriveItems.description: Lists the files and folders under a path in a user's OneDrive, or the root if left blank.

downloadFile.label: Microsoft 365 Download File
downloadFile.description: Downloads the content of a file at a path in a user's OneDrive.

uploadFile.label: Microsoft 365 Upload File
uploadFile.description: Uploads content to a path in a user's OneDrive, creating or overwriting the file.

deleteDriveItem.label: Microsoft 365 Delete Drive Item
deleteDriveItem.description: Deletes a file or folder at a path in a user's OneDrive.

listJoinedTeams.label: Microsoft 365 List Joined Teams
listJoinedTeams.description: Lists the Microsoft Teams teams a user is a member of.

sendChannelMessage.label: Microsoft 365 Send Channel Message
sendChannelMessage.description: Posts a message to a channel in a Microsoft Teams team.

request.label: Microsoft 365 Request
request.description: Sends a raw request to any Microsoft Graph API route not covered by the other Microsoft 365 nodes, e.g. "GET /me/drive".

not.label: Not
not.description: Inverts a boolean value — true becomes false and false becomes true.

code.label: Code
code.description: Runs a user-authored TypeScript script node.

pgpEncrypt.label: PGP Encrypt
pgpEncrypt.description: Encrypts text for a recipient using their armored OpenPGP public key.

pgpDecrypt.label: PGP Decrypt
pgpDecrypt.description: Decrypts an armored OpenPGP message using the recipient's armored private key.

pkcs7Encrypt.label: PKCS7 Encrypt
pkcs7Encrypt.description: Encrypts text into a PKCS#7/CMS EnvelopedData structure (PEM) for a recipient's certificate.

pkcs7Decrypt.label: PKCS7 Decrypt
pkcs7Decrypt.description: Decrypts a PKCS#7/CMS EnvelopedData structure (PEM) using the recipient's private key.

toJson.label: CSV to JSON
toJson.description: Parses a CSV string into a JSON object, wrapping the rows under configurable root/row tags.

toCsv.label: JSON to CSV
toCsv.description: Converts a JSON object's tabular rows into a delimited CSV string.

toXml.label: CSV to XML
toXml.description: Parses a CSV string and converts it into an XML string with configurable root/row tags.

now.label: Now
now.description: Returns the current date and time as a Date.

fromString.label: To Date (String)
fromString.description: Parses a text string into a Date.

fromNumber.label: To Date (Number)
fromNumber.description: Converts a number of milliseconds since epoch into a Date.

subtract.label: Subtract ( - )
subtract.description: Returns the difference between two dates in milliseconds.

equal.label: Equal ( == )
equal.description: True if two dates represent the same moment in time.

unequal.label: Unequal ( != )
unequal.description: True if two dates do not represent the same moment in time.

greaterThan.label: Greater than ( > )
greaterThan.description: True if date A is later than date B.

greaterEqual.label: Greater equal ( >= )
greaterEqual.description: True if date A is later than or the same as date B.

lessThan.label: Less than ( < )
lessThan.description: True if date A is earlier than date B.

lessEqual.label: Less equal ( <= )
lessEqual.description: True if date A is earlier than or the same as date B.

print.label: Print
print.description: Logs a text message to the console for debugging.

printFormatted.label: Print (Formatted)
printFormatted.description: Logs a message pretty-printed according to a chosen format.

start.label: On Start
start.description: Fires once when the graph starts running.

interval.label: On Interval
interval.description: Fires repeatedly on a configurable interval, in milliseconds.

run.label: On Run
run.description: Fires when the editor's own Run button is pressed.

delay.label: Delay
delay.description: Pauses the exec chain for a given duration in milliseconds.

branch.label: Branch
branch.description: Routes execution to True or False based on a condition.

isValid.label: Is Valid
isValid.description: Routes execution to Is Valid or Is Not Valid based on whether the object is null/undefined.

forLoop.label: For Loop
forLoop.description: Runs its Loop Body once for each index from Start to End.

sequence.label: Sequence
sequence.description: Runs each Then branch to completion, one after another.

parallel.label: Parallel
parallel.description: Runs all branches at once and continues once every branch finishes.

entry.label: Entry
entry.description: Starts a function's body and outputs its call's input arguments.

return.label: Return
return.description: Ends a function's body, sending its output values back to the caller.

call.label: Call Function
call.description: Invokes a user-defined function with the given arguments.

request.label: HTTP Request
request.description: Sends an HTTP request with a chosen method, headers, optional auth, and body, returning the response status, body, and headers.

make.label: Make Map
make.description: Builds a new map from the given key-value pairs.

length.label: Map Length
length.description: Returns how many key-value pairs are in the map.

set.label: Map Add
set.description: Sets the value for a key, adding it or overwriting the existing one.

remove.label: Map Remove
remove.description: Removes the entry for a key, if one exists.

clear.label: Map Clear
clear.description: Returns an empty map, discarding all entries.

containsKey.label: Map Contains Key
containsKey.description: True if the map has an entry stored under this key.

find.label: Map Find
find.description: Returns the value stored under a key, and whether it was found.

keys.label: Map Keys
keys.description: Returns an array of every key currently in the map.

values.label: Map Values
values.description: Returns an array of every value currently in the map.

isEmpty.label: Map Is Empty
isEmpty.description: True if the map has no entries.

forEach.label: Map For Each
forEach.description: Runs the loop body once for each key-value pair in the map.

greaterThan.label: Greater than ( > )
greaterThan.description: True if A is greater than B.

greaterEqual.label: Greater equal ( >= )
greaterEqual.description: True if A is greater than or equal to B.

lessThan.label: Less than ( < )
lessThan.description: True if A is less than B.

lessEqual.label: Less equal ( <= )
lessEqual.description: True if A is less than or equal to B.

equal.label: Equal ( == )
equal.description: True if A and B are numerically equal.

unequal.label: Unequal ( != )
unequal.description: True if A and B are not numerically equal.

v2Request.label: OData V2 Request
v2Request.description: Fetches every page of an OData v2 GET request — client-driven $top/$skip (1000 rows per page by default) or server-driven cursor/snapshot next-link paging — and returns the combined rows.

data.label: Reroute
data.description: Bends a wire's path on the canvas with no effect on behavior.

exec.label: Reroute
exec.description: Bends an exec wire's path on the canvas with no effect on behavior.

make.label: Make Set
make.description: Builds a new set from the given elements, dropping duplicates.

length.label: Set Length
length.description: Returns how many unique elements are in the set.

add.label: Set Add
add.description: Adds a value to the set, unless it's already present.

remove.label: Set Remove
remove.description: Removes a value from the set if it is present.

clear.label: Set Clear
clear.description: Returns an empty set, discarding all elements.

contains.label: Set Contains
contains.description: True if the set already contains this value.

isEmpty.label: Set Is Empty
isEmpty.description: True if the set has no elements.

toArray.label: Set To Array
toArray.description: Converts the set's elements into an ordinary array.

union.label: Set Union
union.description: Combines two sets, keeping every distinct element from both.

intersection.label: Set Intersection
intersection.description: Returns only the elements present in both sets.

difference.label: Set Difference
difference.description: Returns elements in the first set that aren't in the second.

forEach.label: Set For Each
forEach.description: Runs the loop body once for each element in the set.

upload.label: SFTP Upload
upload.description: Uploads a file to an SFTP server, with reconnect handling and configurable existing-file behavior. Compiled output only — see this node's own tooltip note below.

fromNumber.label: To String (Number)
fromNumber.description: Converts a number to its text representation.

fromBoolean.label: To String (Boolean)
fromBoolean.description: Converts a boolean to its text representation.

fromDate.label: To String (Date)
fromDate.description: Converts a date to an ISO 8601 text string.

fromJson.label: To String (JSON)
fromJson.description: Converts a value to its JSON text representation.

equalCaseSensitive.label: Equal ( == ) case-sensitive
equalCaseSensitive.description: True if two strings are exactly equal, case-sensitive.

equalCaseInsensitive.label: Equal ( == ) case-insensitive
equalCaseInsensitive.description: True if two strings are equal, ignoring letter case.

length.label: Length
length.description: Returns how many characters are in the string.

replace.label: Replace
replace.description: Replaces only the first occurrence of a substring with another string.

replaceAll.label: Replace All
replaceAll.description: Replaces every occurrence of a substring with another string.

substring.label: Substring
substring.description: Returns the characters between Start and End (order-independent, clamped to the string's bounds).

slice.label: Slice
slice.description: Returns the characters between Start and End, where a negative index counts from the string's end.

append.label: Append String
append.description: Concatenates all of its string inputs into one result.

get.label: Get Variable
get.description: Reads the bound variable's current value.

set.label: Set Variable
set.description: Writes a new value to the bound variable.

toJson.label: XML to JSON
toJson.description: Parses an XML string into a JSON object, failing safely with success:false on invalid XML.

fromJson.label: JSON to XML
fromJson.description: Builds an XML string from a JSON object.

toCsv.label: XML to CSV
toCsv.description: Parses an XML string's tabular rows and converts them into a delimited CSV string.
